The Glide REST API (v2) for working with Glide Big Tables. Create and overwrite tables, list and paginate rows, read a single row, add rows, update and delete rows, stage large batches with stashes, and query tables with SQL. All requests are authenticated with a Bearer API token issued from the Glide team settings. The API operates at the team level and works with Glide Big Tables.
